name: Fujino Risa
source:
The mother of Haruki, Minato's friend. She is normally kind and gentle. Is in a good relationship with her husband, and has sex regularly. However, she's still unsatisfied that she craves for sex so much. 

[Translated from [url=http://www.appetite-game.com/apt_059.html#char]Official Site[/url]]
